name: spirv-llvm-translator
description: A library and utility for converting between LLVM IR and SPIR-V code.
build: cd SPIRV-LLVM-Translator-21.1.4 && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -D CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON -D LLVM_EXTERNAL_SPIRV_HEADERS_SOURCE_DIR=/usr -G Ninja .. && ninja $MAKEOPTS
